info.name: Quick notes
info.summary: Quick notes on small cards, with colors, tags, attachments, reminders and sharing
info.description:
Take quick notes on small cards, organized by colors and tags, with basic rich text — bold, italic, lists — and any file of your Nextcloud attached to them.
Notes can be shared with other people and with groups, and every share says what it allows: can view, can edit, or pass the note on. Editing a shared note is real collaboration, and if two people save at once the second one is told rather than quietly overwriting the first. The attachments travel with the note: whoever can see it can see them, and images, video and audio open in the Nextcloud viewer.
What belongs to the note is the same for everybody — the title, the content, the colour, the attachments. What belongs to you is yours: your pin, your tags, your reminder and whether you archived it. Pinning a note somebody shared with you does not pin it for them, and two people can be reminded of the same note at their own time.
A reminder arrives as a Nextcloud notification, and can also be published as a read-only calendar for the Calendar app and any CalDAV client.
info.author: Matias De lellis
